subject.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI

question: Should the Control UI guarantee conflict attention for unexpanded descendant sessions, and if so should the session-list projection carry an aggregate count or should the sidebar load the required child metadata before rendering collapsed parents?
rationale: The observable recovery requirement is clear, but the choice between extending the session projection and eagerly loading child rows affects the Control UI data contract and list-loading behavior.

options.title: Expose aggregate descendant conflict counts
options.body: Add bounded conflict-attention metadata to the session-list/tree projection so collapsed rows remain informative without fetching hidden children.

options.title: Load hidden child metadata on refresh
options.body: Keep the current projection shape but fetch the child rows needed to compute conflict attention before rendering a collapsed parent.

recommendation.title: Expose aggregate descendant conflict counts
recommendation.body: Add bounded conflict-attention metadata to the session-list/tree projection so collapsed rows remain informative without fetching hidden children.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged cloud-worker conflict projection and the proposed Control UI recovery surface.
